profile.host: macOS with Linux aarch64 Docker Desktop daemon

adaptations: Generated protected environment with --skip-start and immutable image; explicitly corrected stale template MINDDY_RELEASE from 0.10.30 to 0.11.0. Installer has no --release flag.
Initial verbose pull exceeded the installer output buffer. Exact Compose pull --quiet succeeded; installer resumed with --skip-pull.
Frozen release dependency installed jose 6.2.12 but offline bundle requires 6.2.3. Scratch compilation used the 6.2.3 package already present in the frozen lock; source/tag files remained unchanged.
Signed OCI runner lacked agent-runner-storage.mjs. Engineering Compose override mounted the matching tagged source helper read-only.

macOS host does not provide the Linux GNU tar interface. Linux helper archived the inspected stopped database and Storage bindings with numeric ownership, ACLs and xattrs; saved database image archived db-config.
Docker Desktop source data existed inside the Linux VM for new /var bindings. The backup explicitly mounted those inspected bindings rather than copying an empty macOS directory.

Initial macOS file-sharing Storage restore returned HTTP 500 ENOTSUP for extended attributes. A verified-new Linux Docker volume was restored from the same archive with xattrs, then mounted by the persistent target override.
GnuPG initial deep temporary homedir exceeded Unix socket length; a fresh short private homedir completed the encryption test.

actualResults.outerEncryptionTool: GnuPG AES256 with a fresh private passphrase file; exact decrypted SHA256 checked, artifacts and keys outside repository
